## What happened?

## Expected behavior and reproduction steps

## Environment

Script version, browser version, userscript manager/version, display mode, selected local profile (use a generic label), and whether other script copies were disabled.

## Evidence

Attach a synthetic or cropped private-data-free screenshot if helpful. A reviewed report from Settings → Diagnostics → Preview may help. It is optional and contains usage times/plan labels. Never attach HAR files, tokens, cookies, real conversation URLs or raw localStorage. Sensitive security issues belong in the private reporting channel described in SECURITY.md.

## Scope

Does the issue persist after refreshing every affected tab? Is it within one browser storage partition? Did any quota setting, script version or selected local profile change?
